name: capture_perfetto_trace
description: Capture a timed Perfetto trace from a connected Meta Quest device. The trace runs for the specified duration and stops automatically. Modes: 'standard' (default, CPU scheduling + GPU counters + XR runtime), 'gpu' (render stages + Vulkan), 'cpu' (extended scheduling, no GPU overhead), 'lightweight' (markers only, minimal impact), 'full' (everything), 'custom' (individual flags). For manual start/stop, use start_perfetto_capture and stop_perfetto_capture instead.

app.description: App package name to trace (e.g., 'com.example.myapp'). If not specified, auto-detects.

cpu_scheduling.description: Enable CPU scheduling tracing. Only with mode 'custom'.

duration_ms.description: Duration of capture in milliseconds. Default is 5000 (5 seconds).

extended_scheduling.description: Enable extended scheduling events. Only with mode 'custom'.

gpu_metrics.description: Enable GPU metrics tracing. Only with mode 'custom'.

gpu_render_stage.description: Enable GPU render stage tracing. Only with mode 'custom'.

mode.description: Capture mode preset: 'standard' (default, CPU scheduling + GPU counters + XR runtime), 'gpu' (render stages + Vulkan), 'cpu' (extended scheduling, no GPU), 'lightweight' (markers only), 'full' (everything), 'custom' (use individual flags).

output_name.description: Output filename (without extension). If not specified, generates a timestamp-based name.

vulkan_layer.description: Enable Vulkan OS layer tracing. Only with mode 'custom'.

xr_runtime.description: Enable XR runtime metrics. Only with mode 'custom'.
